question.text: NAV is rounded to how many decimal places per SEBI norms?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, NAV is rounded up to four decimal places for both fund-level and series-level NAV. The Trap: Whole number/two/six decimals are not prescribed. Cross-Exam Context: Stricter than standard MF NAV (V-A) which uses four decimals as well.
